subject: prd/worker-transcript-metrics
intent: every launched agent process is **accounted for** — by a schema-valid record, or by an explicit capture-failure entry naming it
fit_criterion: 100% of launched processes accounted for, the two sets partitioning the launched set with no process in neither, at the checkpoint of one batch spanning every supported harness. **The denominator is the authoritative launch record (FR-13), produced by the executor — never capture's own event stream**, which cannot emit anything for a process whose capture never ran
